disclaimer: National context. Synthetic pilot operations. No utility connection or physical control.
title: An informed view. A traceable decision.
subtitle: Explore a pilot energy scenario, compare the evidence, and connect an operator decision to a customer response.
welcomeBody: Enter a demonstration workspace. Personas are fictional and selectable by anyone; this is not verified utility authentication.
welcomePoint1: Follow the calculation, not a generated number.
welcomePoint2: Keep customer choice separate from measured delivery.
welcomePoint3: See missing data before making a decision.
draftTranslations: Sinhala / Tamil copy is a prototype draft; voice is not enabled.
mapBody: Sourced country outline; markers are fictional pilot examples, not registered power plants.
mapLabel: Sri Lanka outline with selectable synthetic pilot locations
noTelemetry: No verified plant output, line flows, frequency, or national totals are connected.
chartBody: Hourly simulation · essential-first allocation · power in kW
chartLabel: Pilot hourly solar generation and demand
strategyBody: The engine reserves lifeline allocations before sharing remaining supply. These rules do not solve national electrical power flow.
scheduleTitle: Move a flexible load. Preserve the service.
scheduleBody: A synthetic 2 kW pump needs two contiguous hours before 22:00. Exhaustive search finds the cheapest allowed start. Illustrative rates, not an approved tariff.
evidenceBody: All three allocation policies use the same scenario. The pump scheduler compares feasible start times using the stated rates; it does not control equipment. Result IDs below identify the calculations.
eventTitle: From an operator request to a verified replay
eventBody: One fictional interval customer can participate. Acceptance alone provides no verified reduction or firm reserve.
gapWarning: One replay interval is missing. Verification will be blocked; accepting the invitation does not fill this gap.
noReward: No real reward, payment, or utility commitment is created.
confirmationBody: Confirm the exact action and current event version below. This affects synthetic records only. Concurrent changes require a new review.
accountBody: A responsive customer companion using the same event service. Native Android / iOS clients and utility account linking are not yet implemented.
billExplanation: Fixture comparison: {usage} kWh more usage and LKR {cost} more billed than the previous fixture period. This is a record comparison, not proof of appliance behavior or a tariff reconstruction.
outageTitle: One service event, consistent on both sides
outageBody: Synthetic planned interruption for the selected demo service point. The end time is a fixture estimate, not confirmed restoration.
monthlyWarning: Monthly readings cannot verify a two-hour response. Interval participation and short-interval charts are unavailable for this account.
noOffer: No active invitation. An operator must publish the demo event first.
careNotice: Payments, official complaints, voice, live outages, and appliance controls require separate integrations and remain unavailable.
auditEmpty: No sandbox actions yet. Publish an invitation to start the trace.
sourcePilot: Pilot model / interval replay · synthetic fixtures
sourceUtility: Utility SCADA, billing, AMI, OMS, CRM · unavailable
persistence: Local SQLite sandbox. Event and audit survive refresh/restart; sessions expire on server restart. Single-host development adapter.

errors.unauthorized: Enter a sandbox persona to continue.
errors.forbidden: This persona is not permitted to perform that action.
errors.interval_account_required: This action requires the eligible interval-data demo customer.
errors.version_conflict: The event changed. Review its latest state before confirming again.
errors.invalid_transition: That action is no longer valid in the current event state.
errors.confirmation_invalid: Confirmation expired or does not match this session. Review again.
errors.insufficient_data: Verification blocked: replay intervals are incomplete.
errors.demo_disabled: The sandbox is disabled in this environment.
errors.unavailable: A service is unavailable. Your action is not confirmed.
errors.session_expired: The demo session expired. Select a persona again.
errors.invalid_request: The request was invalid. Refresh and try again.
